desc.it: Marchio (immaginario) di birra di un birrificio veneto delle Dolomiti, nato nel 2022. 'Bando' viene dal dialetto: la parola con cui i bambini chiedono una pausa nel gioco. Il brand celebra la birra come tradizione che unisce le persone — distribuzione pensata dal canale Horeca alla grande distribuzione.
desc.en: A (fictional) beer brand from a Veneto brewery in the Dolomites, born in 2022. 'Bando' comes from local dialect — the word kids use to call a break in a game. The brand celebrates beer as a tradition that brings people together — distribution planned from Horeca to mass retail.

p.it:
•⁠ ⁠Lead design sito istituzionale peekaboovision.com: end-to-end da Figma a WordPress/Elementor, con UI/UX monitoring che ha ridotto il caricamento del 35% e aumentato la retention del 22%.
•⁠ ⁠Prodotto 150+ contenuti digitali e montaggio di 10+ video lessons, con animazioni per newsletter/eventi. •⁠ ⁠Brand identity e landing page MVP per 20+ founder del Lean Startup Program. •⁠ Gestion e 100+ articoli blog e SEO con 3 stagisti, aumentando visualizzazioni organiche del 35% e CTR del 30% in 6 mesi.
p.en:
• Lead designer for the peekaboovision.com corporate website: end-to-end development from Figma to WordPress/Elementor, with UI/UX optimisation that reduced loading times by 35% and increased retention by 22%.
• Produced over 150 pieces of digital content and edited over 10 video lessons, including animations for newsletters and events.
•⁠ ⁠Brand identity and MVP landing pages for 20+ founders of the Lean Startup Programme.
•⁠ ⁠Managed 100+ blog articles and SEO with 3 interns, increasing organic views by 35% and CTR by 30% in 6 months.

p.en:
•⁠ Provided ongoing UI/UX consultancy for the Ticketoo app, optimising key workflows (checkout, tickets, banners), resulting in a 28% reduction in checkout drop-off and an increase in conversion rates.
•⁠ ⁠Implemented 5 new main user workflows on the app, testing them with over 120 real users.
•⁠ Created over 20 UI components within the design system, reducing time-to-design and standardising the platform’s visual elements.

p.en:
